controls.title: No non-system subject is bound to cluster-admin
controls.expectedState: Only recognized system service accounts/groups are bound to the cluster-admin ClusterRole.

controls.title: No workload container runs privileged
controls.expectedState: No container outside kube-system/kube-public/kube-node-lease sets securityContext.privileged=true.

controls.title: No workload pod uses the host network
controls.expectedState: No pod outside kube-system/kube-public/kube-node-lease sets hostNetwork=true.

controls.title: Every workload namespace has a NetworkPolicy
controls.expectedState: Every namespace outside kube-system/kube-public/kube-node-lease has at least one NetworkPolicy.

controls.title: Cluster break-glass procedure is documented
controls.expectedState: A documented, tested break-glass procedure exists for cluster-admin access.
